scope: Real TalkBack focus and double-tap gestures, native recording and cancellation on the Android 16 emulator. Host audio disabled; no audibility, live speech or full accessibility acceptance. Extended flow verifies scripted note correction, review, explicit confirmation and already-open caregiver visibility using actual screen-reader gestures.

checks.name: Actual TalkBack and its offline English voice are active; the saved hold preference is overridden by accessible tap mode
TalkBack forward gestures reach the labelled recording button without starting capture
A real TalkBack double-tap starts native recording and exposes the send label and transient capture file
TalkBack gestures reach and activate Cancel; capture stops, cached audio is removed, and no upload is sent
TalkBack recording returns an unsaved note; gesture navigation reaches the review and its named recipient
TalkBack correction replaces the old context; the corrected read-back, recipient and explicit Confirm control are reachable before saving
TalkBack double-tap confirms one corrected phone-sourced note; the already-open permitted caregiver updates and the restricted caregiver does not
Resuming the TalkBack-enabled companion preserves the one confirmed record without replaying a voice upload
